judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

P. Dhanabal, J.:— This Criminal Original Petition has been filed to modify the condition imposed in Cr.M.P. No. 169 of 2026 dated 4-2-2026 passed by the principal Special Court for Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act Cases, Madurai.

2. Heard both sides.

3. Considering the rival submissions made by either side, the condition imposed by the learned Sessions Judge, principal Special Court for Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act Cases, Madurai in Cr.M.P. No. 169 of 2026 dated 4-2-2026 is modified to the effect that:

• the petitioner has to produce the sureties from his own locality;

• the other conditions imposed in the said order shall remain intact.

4. Accordingly, this Criminal Original Petition is ordered.
